name: Piece by Piece
source: As a kid, Shelly and her two twin friends, Ed and Raf, often played together and hid puzzles in her house. Ten years later, when they reunited and uncover one of the puzzles, the answers led them to a place that shouldn't have existed.
translation: 小时候，雪莉和她的两个双胞胎朋友埃德和拉夫经常一起玩耍，并在她的房子里藏拼图。十年后，当他们重聚并揭开其中一个谜题时，答案将他们带到了一个不应该存在的地方。
